**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] Pod web-logger created in exam-q1
- [ ] Main container `web` uses nginx:1.27-alpine
- [ ] Native sidecar `log-agent` is an initContainer with restartPolicy: Always
- [ ] Shared emptyDir `logs` mounted at /var/log/nginx in both containers
- [ ] Manifest saved to /opt/course/p1/web-logger.yaml

**Solution:**

A native sidecar is an `initContainer` with `restartPolicy: Always` — it starts before the main containers and keeps running alongside them.

```yaml
# /opt/course/p1/web-logger.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web-logger
  namespace: exam-q1
spec:
  volumes:
    - name: logs
      emptyDir: {}
  initContainers:
    - name: log-agent
      image: busybox:1.36
      restartPolicy: Always      # <- makes it a native sidecar
      command: ["sh", "-c", "tail -F /var/log/nginx/access.log"]
      volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log/nginx
  containers:
    - name: web
      image: nginx:1.27-alpine
      volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log/nginx
```

```bash
k apply -f /opt/course/p1/web-logger.yaml
k -n exam-q1 get pod web-logger
```

**Verification:**

```bash
k -n exam-q1 get pod web-logger -o jsonpath='{.spec.initContainers[0].restartPolicy}'
# Expected: Always
```

---
criteria: Native sidecar is an initContainer with restartPolicy Always
Shared emptyDir mounted in both containers

- [ ] DaemonSet node-agent created in exam-q2
- [ ] Image is busybox:1.36
- [ ] Pod label app=node-agent
- [ ] One Pod scheduled per node

**Solution:**

There is no `kubectl create daemonset` generator, so create a Deployment YAML and convert it, or write it directly:

```yaml
# ds.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-agent
  namespace: exam-q2
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: node-agent
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: agent
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sh", "-c", "while true; do echo agent alive; sleep 30; done"]
```

```bash
k apply -f ds.yaml
k -n exam-q2 get ds node-agent
k -n exam-q2 get pods -o wide
```

**Verification:** DESIRED == CURRENT == number of schedulable nodes.

Create the green Deployment (copy app-blue, rename, change labels/image):

```yaml
# /opt/course/p4/app-green.yaml

metadata:

  namespace: exam-q4

    version: green

    matchLabels:
```

**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] Root cause identified (invalid command)
- [ ] Deployment fixed to run busybox:1.36 with the correct command
- [ ] 3 replicas Running
- [ ] Root cause written to /opt/course/p8/issues.txt

**Solution:**

Inspect first:

```bash
k -n exam-q8 get pods
k -n exam-q8 logs deploy/data-processor
k -n exam-q8 describe pod -l app=data-processor | tail -20
```

The container was deployed with a nonexistent command (e.g. `sh -c 'processs'`), causing an exec error and CrashLoopBackOff. Fix it:

```bash
k -n exam-q8 edit deploy data-processor
```

```yaml
command: ["sh", "-c", "while true; do echo processing; sleep 10; done"]
```

Write the root cause:

```bash
echo 'Container command was invalid (binary not found), causing CrashLoopBackOff. Replaced with a valid sh loop.' > /opt/course/p8/issues.txt
k -n exam-q8 rollout status deploy/data-processor
```

**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] File rewritten to networking.k8s.io/v1 Ingress schema
- [ ] backend uses service.name/service.port.number
- [ ] pathType Prefix and ingressClassName nginx
- [ ] Applied into exam-q9

**Solution:**

The removed `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1` shape used `serviceName`/`servicePort`. The v1 schema nests them under `backend.service`:

```yaml
# /opt/course/p9/legacy-ingress.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: legacy-ingress
  namespace: exam-q9
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: legacy.ckad.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: legacy-svc
                port:
                  number: 80
```

```bash
k apply -f /opt/course/p9/legacy-ingress.yaml
k -n exam-q9 get ingress legacy-ingress
```

**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] ConfigMap web-config with LOG_LEVEL and app.conf
- [ ] Secret web-secret with the API_KEY key
- [ ] Pod consumer exposes LOG_LEVEL (CM) and API_KEY (Secret) as env
- [ ] ConfigMap mounted as volume at /etc/web

**Solution:**

```bash
k -n exam-q10 create configmap web-config \
  --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info \
  --from-literal=app.conf='mode=prod'

k -n exam-q10 create secret generic web-secret \
  --from-literal=API_KEY=<value-from-task>
```

Replace `<value-from-task>` with the value given in the question. Pod consuming both:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: consumer
  namespace: exam-q10
spec:
  volumes:
    - name: cfg
      configMap:
        name: web-config
  containers:
    - name: consumer
      image: nginx:alpine
      env:
        - name: LOG_LEVEL
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: web-config
              key: LOG_LEVEL
        - name: API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: web-secret
              key: API_KEY
      volumeMounts:
        - name: cfg
          mountPath: /etc/web
```

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: hardened
  namespace: exam-q11
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsUser: 1000
    runAsGroup: 2000
    runAsNonRoot: true
  volumes:
    - name: scratch
      emptyDir: {}
  containers:
    - name: hardened
      image: busybox:1.36
      command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
      securityContext:
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        capabilities:
          drop: ["ALL"]
          add: ["NET_BIND_SERVICE"]
      volumeMounts:
        - name: scratch
          mountPath: /tmp
```

```bash
k apply -f hardened.yaml
k -n exam-q11 get pod hardened
```

**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] Pod quota-pod created within team-quota
- [ ] CPU request 100m / limit 250m
- [ ] Memory request 128Mi / limit 256Mi
- [ ] Pod scheduled

**Solution:**

When a ResourceQuota constrains CPU/memory, every Pod must declare requests and limits or it is rejected.

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: quota-pod
  namespace: exam-q12
spec:
  containers:
    - name: quota-pod
      image: nginx:alpine
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 128Mi
        limits:
          cpu: 250m
          memory: 256Mi
```

```bash
k apply -f quota-pod.yaml
k -n exam-q12 describe resourcequota team-quota
```

**Solution:**

The imperative command produces an autoscaling/v2 HPA:

```bash
k -n exam-q15 autoscale deploy scaler-app \
  --name scaler-hpa --min 2 --max 10 --cpu-percent 70
```

Equivalent YAML:

```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: scaler-hpa
  namespace: exam-q15
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: scaler-app
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
```

answers.body:
**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] Service selector fixed to app=shop
- [ ] Service targetPort fixed to 80
- [ ] Endpoints populated / Service reachable

**Solution:**

A Service with no endpoints almost always means selector or targetPort mismatch:

```bash
k -n exam-q16 get endpoints shop-svc      # empty = no matching pods
k -n exam-q16 get pods --show-labels
k -n exam-q16 get svc shop-svc -o yaml
```

Fix both fields:

```bash
k -n exam-q16 patch svc shop-svc -p \
  '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"shop"},"ports":[{"port":80,"targetPort":80}]}}'
k -n exam-q16 get endpoints shop-svc      # now shows pod IPs
```

**Weight: 5%**

- [ ] NetworkPolicy api-policy selects app=api
- [ ] Ingress from app=client on TCP 80
- [ ] Egress to app=db on TCP 5432
- [ ] Egress to DNS on UDP+TCP 53

**Solution:**

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-policy
  namespace: exam-q17
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: client
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 80
  egress:
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: db
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53
```

```bash
k apply -f api-policy.yaml
```

- [ ] PVC content-pvc requests 1Gi, RWO, StorageClass standard
- [ ] Pod content-pod mounts PVC at /usr/share/nginx/html
- [ ] PVC Bound, Pod Running

**Solution:**

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: content-pvc
  namespace: exam-q19
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  storageClassName: standard
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: content-pod
  namespace: exam-q19
spec:
  volumes:
    - name: content
      persistentVolumeClaim:
        claimName: content-pvc
  containers:
    - name: content-pod
      image: nginx:alpine
      volumeMounts:
        - name: content
          mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
```

```bash
k apply -f content.yaml
k -n exam-q19 get pvc content-pvc
k -n exam-q19 get pod content-pod
```
